paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yishmael, sons of Yishua: Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot, chapter 7, end of halakhah 6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied text reads בגי יישוע. The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:6 explicitly has רבי יוחנן ורבי ישמעאל בני יישוע, “sons of Yishua”; the translation follows that reading. This comparison does not establish the history of the supplied letter form.

The actual Guggenheimer digital paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:6 has Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yishmael, sons of Yishua. The supplied בגי and the digital בני remain distinct witnesses. The English follows the named digital reading as the existing note explains; this does not prove a typographical or correction history or admit a genealogical identity.
